answer_1.quote: Towards the event records extraction in the DEE task, we propose a novel Iteratively Parallel Generation method with the Pre-Filling strategy (IPGPF). IPGPF generates event roles in parallel and iteratively generates event records with the help of the pre-filling strategy.
